- MTS Fintech (2020-2021) — Team Lead (PHP): team of 5–7, centralized config microservice from scratch (DDD), RBAC, 85% test coverage
- Webguru.pro (2017-2020) — CTO / Co-founder: 50+ projects (AB InBev, MegaFon, Alliance Retail Group), AliceBot.pro SaaS, team of 5–8
- ETP Gazprombank (2016-2020) — Senior PHP Developer: 44-FZ/223-FZ EIS integration, billing microservice on Phalcon, PHP 5.6→7
- Avito (2016) — PHP Developer: billing microservice, MIR card integration
- Mamba/Tourbar (2015-2016) — PHP Developer: REST API for mobile apps, Elasticsearch search over millions of profiles
